repos_data.description: Free Zip / Unzip software and Rar file extractor. Cross-platform file and archive manager. Features volume spanning, compression, authenticated encryption. Supports 7Z, 7-Zip sfx, ACE, ARJ, Brotli, BZ2, CAB, CHM, CPIO, DEB, GZ, ISO, JAR, LHA/LZH, NSIS, OOo, PAQ/LPAQ, PEA, QUAD, RAR, RPM, split, TAR, Z, ZIP, ZIPX, Zstandard.
a streaming interface for archive generation
Mail-Archiver is a web application for archiving, searching, and exporting emails from multiple accounts. Featuring folder sync, attachment support, mailbox migration  and a dashboard.
Archive manager and 7zip replacement for macOS. Preview (nested) archives without extracting them. Extract single files.
